capabilities: Convert files, folders, and ZIP archives into Markdown notes
OCR image files into text notes
Import web pages and YouTube/Bilibili links as notes
Set up and manage a vault-local Python conversion environment
extras: Desktop-only plugin; requires Python 3.10+ installed locally, with setup and environment checks built into the settings page. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bulk-convert PDFs, Office files, images, audio, archives, or video links into Markdown notes.
summary: Multi-format importer that converts files, folders, ZIP archives, images, audio, web pages, and YouTube/Bilibili links into Markdown notes.
